name: Banyan Snare
subtitle: Old Temple Banyan
mechanism: Wall. 300 HP outlasts the Cyclo Zombie's 200 crash. Whenever it is hurt and its roots are ready, every enemy within root_radius is rooted in place (HungryGhost.apply_slow(0, root_duration)), then the roots rest root_cooldown s. Event-driven: no per-frame work.

abilities.name: Root Snare
abilities.trigger: Takes damage while its roots are ready
abilities.effect: Roots every enemy within 2.2 m for 2.5 s; ready again 4 s later.

clipAnnotations.attack: Aerial roots fling outward and drop back.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the lawn.
